name: Sudoku Solver
description: Solves a 9×9 Sudoku puzzle by trying each digit 1-9 in empty cells, backtracking when a conflict is detected.
aim: Fill a Sudoku grid by recursively placing digits 1-9 in empty cells and backtracking when any row, column, or 3×3 box constraint is violated.
howItWorks: Check validity: digit not in same row, column, or 3×3 box
If valid: place digit, recurse to next empty cell
If recursion fails: remove digit and try next (backtrack)
If all cells filled: solution found

complexity.spaceDescription: Grid storage + recursion stack depth up to n²=81

realWorld: Puzzle generation by solving with backtrack counting
whenToUse: When search space is bounded and constraint propagation helps
alternatives: Constraint propagation (Arc Consistency) — prunes far more before backtracking
Dancing Links (DLX) — Knuth's optimized exact cover algorithm

inputHint: Nine rows of nine digits, 0 for an empty cell, rows separated by "/".
